question: Submission description (a short paragraph)
answer: GEMBA-poly-cand is a reference-free, LLM-based quality estimation metric built on Llama 3.3 70B. Following the poly-cand approach introduced in Züfle et al. (2025, "COMET-poly: Machine Translation Metric Grounded in Other Candidates"), each translation is scored alongside up to 5 additional candidate translations of the same source segment, selected by cosine similarity over all-MiniLM-L12-v2 sentence embeddings, giving the model contrastive context rather than scoring the translation in isolation. Candidate pools are drawn primarily from other participating systems' outputs for the same source segment; for segments with too few available system outputs, additional synthetic candidates were generated with TranslateGemma-4B to ensure a sufficient pool for similarity-based selection.
